scoping_rule_built: A client-human (principal_class CLIENT: authorizer email non-empty, userType not service, firmId not 'null' and not the internal firm 'opal-capital') reaching LIST gets only the tickets with ticket_type == 'analysis_request' AND requester.firm == the caller's authorizer firmId. The firm is taken from the authorizer context ONLY (actor['firmId'] from _actor at lambda_function.py:308-317, read in client_list_tickets at :1328-1355). Any query member other than status and limit (so firm, selected_tenant, ticket_type, assignee, email) is refused 400 and reads nothing. A firm id that fails _FIRM_ID_RE (lambda_function.py:133) returns an EMPTY list with 200, never all. A client-human with no firm is UNRESOLVABLE and is refused 403 by the matrix before any scan.

projection_built.excluded: events, description, client_updates, assignee, requester (email and name), created_by, source, routing, attachment, linked_submission_id, every package pointer value, and every other firm's row
projection_built.package_state: NONE when no package is stored or none of the four pointer kinds (report_ref, pdf_ref, original_ref, commentary_ref; PACKAGE_REF_FIELDS at lambda_function.py:137) is a non-empty string; COMPLETE when every applicable pointer is a non-empty string, where original_ref stored as null is not applicable (the custody-lane case); PARTIAL otherwise. Only the word is returned, never the pointer values. Code: _package_state at :1283-1298, _client_projection at :1306-1313.

bound_built.constant: CLIENT_LIST_MAX_SCAN_PAGES = 20 (lambda_function.py:1279, with the 29-item measurement and the firm-index trigger in the comment block above it at :1268-1277)
bound_built.rule: the client scan is _table.scan() with no Limit (_scan_all_pages at :1314-1326), following LastEvaluatedKey; at most 20 pages are read; if the 20th page still carries a LastEvaluatedKey the answer is 503 with 'list incomplete: ... no partial list is returned' and no tickets, count or cutoff.
